articleTitle: Study on Universal Bus Interface Based on Sequence Configuration
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: Universal bus interface is very helpful for improving the popularity of the device or equipment on both SoC integration and board level computing system design. Because of the diversity of bus interface accessing protocol, universality is usually unable to be achieved in a common interface design. Through introducing the concept of sequence configuration, a method of designing universal bus interface was proposed in this paper. The concept of the bus accessing sequence configuration was analyzed, the specification definition of the universal interface was elaborated and then the architecture was discussed. As a case study, a universal bus writer was implemented and embedded in a FPGA based computing system in real use. Application status shows that the universal bus interface designed through this method can be configured into various kinds of bus interface access timing with distinct cost advantage.

articleTitle: A Goal Model of Autonomous Agent Organization
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: When a task is received by an agent organization in multi-agent system (MAS), it should be partitioned into multiple subtasks which will be assigned to suitable agents to be pursued. A goal model of autonomous agent organization (GMAAO) is proposed in which a trigger mechanism of event is added to the traditional "AND/OR" task decomposition tree to deal with the event-driven feature of MAS, and the task decomposition method can reduce the task cost greatly. A case study shows that the creation of goal instances is triggered by event dynamically, and the task overhead can be reduced since the task decomposition path with lowest overhead can be chosen.

articleTitle: Frequent Itemsets Discovery Algorithm and Its Application Based on Frequent Matrix
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: There are varieties of linkages among the properties of the data in a large database, These linkages are hidden in the data of the database, the purpose of association mining is to identify these hidden association rules. The discovery of association rules is based on frequent itemsets, so how could we make frequent itemsets fast and accurate is the main research of association data mining. In this paper, a matrix-based frequent discovery algorithm is raised according to the problems in the existing algorithms in finding frequent itemsets, and it has a practical application in the automobile fault parts association analysis system of automotive industry chain business intelligence platform..

articleTitle: Speed Control Algorithm for Automatic Train Operation Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: One-level speed adjustment braking of automatic train operation (ATO) system is studied in this paper. An approach of adaptive fuzzy control is proposed aiming at improving speed control performance, passenger comfort and operation efficiency. Shrinkage factor of variable universe is used to optimize quantization factor of fuzzy controller and the scale factor is adjusted by fuzzy reasoning. The simulation results show effectively on train location parking.

articleTitle: Evaluation on Web-Based Learning System New Horizon College English
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: The evaluation of Web-based learning system has been one of the most talked about issue over the recent years. New Horizon College English (NHCE), as one of the most popular Web-based English learning system in Universities, also needs to be evaluated on a broader concept. NHCE system (second edition in 2008) was briefly introduced in this paper first. A review of the literature enabled to generate 10 items that were mainly grouped into five parts: communication, quiz depot, online classroom, learning tools and overall expectation. The reliability of the questionnaire was first tested by partial least square (PLS). Next, the students completed the ten-item questionnaire. Then summative evaluation was carried out on Web-based English system NHCE with analysis of PLS. At the same time, performance evaluation was conducted, namely, students' performance online and in the final exam were compared and analyzed to evaluate effectiveness of NHCE with T-test and F-test. Problems existing in the system were also examined and suggestions were proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Dynamic Particle Swarm Optimization Based on Anti-Mistake and Sinai Chaos
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: To solve the premature problem of particle swarm optimization, firstly, the dynamic nonlinear inertia weights are designed which can make particles retain the favorable conditions and converge to the global optima continually; secondly, two kinds of anti-mistake equations are introduced which can make the stagnated particles break away from the local optima and dynamically search the global optima; at the same time, the Sinai chaos is introduced which can enrich search behaviors and make particles travel the whole search space. Experimental results demonstrated that the new introduced methods outperformed several other improved particle swarm optimization algorithms on many famous benchmark problems.

articleTitle: From Ex Ante Limited Cognition to Ex Post Negotiations Breakdown: An Explanation of Taxi Strike in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: This paper explains the phenomenon that taxi drivers of all over the country on strike with bounded rationality model, and draws several conclusions. First of all, Parties' limited cognition leads to contracts are incomplete, which will require renegotiation. The main reason of the strike is that taxi drivers own little power on the renegotiation but not the increased rent, unauthorized taxi and so on. Secondly, in order to acquire much more renegotiation power they adopt this extremely behavior. This phenomenon, on one hand, indicates that the taxi industry is still under developing; on the other hand, it implies the disadvantage of the current institution.

articleTitle: SDO Based Data Integration Solution for Civil Aviation Information System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: This paper discusses the data integration solution for the civil aviation information system which is based on SOA and deals with many kinds of data from various machines and places. Therefore the need of heterogeneous data integration becomes a pretty important concern of the overall design of the system. SDO provides us with a unified and mature programming framework for SOA based development. So here we state how to effectively embed SDO in the development of our system. It includes a data integration solution for a common enterprise application and the extension on top of traditional SDO usage.

articleTitle: An Improved Ant Colony Optimization and Its Applications in Flow-Shop Problems
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: Ant colony optimization (ACO) is easily relapsed into local optimization and stagnation. In order to ameliorate this problem existed in ACO, several new improvements are proposed and evaluated. Such as, stochastic search strategy and pheromone mutation were inducted. Then an improved ant colony optimization with pheromone mutation (PMACO) was put forward. It was tested by a set of benchmark travelling salesman problems from the travelling salesman problem library and some flow-shop problems. The results of the examples show that it can not easily run into the local optimum and can converge at the global optimum. It performs better than the other algorithms such as genetic algorithm in solving flowshop problems.

articleTitle: Learning Model of Corporate Social Responsibility: In View of Corporate Governance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: Corporate governance structure is the configuration mechanism between shareholders, creditors, employees and other stakeholders in the right company. There may be some convergence and mutual influence between CSR and corporate governance, especially in the west. An effective corporate governance system will prevents the occurrence of illegal actions which damage the interests of those stakeholders, while an effective corporate social responsibility statute helps to avoid those who are legitimate but not the appropriate action. However, under the imperfect governance structure and external environment in China, corporate governance had a unilateral effects on CSR. Governance structures under various social contractual environment determine the main content of corporate social responsibility and then change the behavior of corporate. Companies will improve the response process and policies through the study of social responsibility and adjust their behaviors. More importantly, based on the degree of overlapping between social expectations and Community responding, the paper analyzes how companies improve their efficiency of responding process through continuous learning.

articleTitle: The Research and Emulation of Traffic Optimal Routing Problem Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: It's necessary to choose the optimal route in traffic network. Various foreign researchers have done a lot of research and improvement. The traditional optimal routing algorithms were represented by Dijkstra algorithm, and they all not only had high complexity but also had the disadvantage of not reflecting the dynamic very well. In this paper, a new algorithm about choosing the optimal routing problem based on ant colony algorithm was presented. Using the dataset to simulate the algorithm and compare with the classical algorithm. The result represented that it has much more advantages than the classical when the traffic network has more nodes and more complex routings.

articleTitle: The Educational Mission of University from the View of Ecological Civilization
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: As the main battlefield of creation knowledge and dissemination knowledge, universities are becoming the center of the society gradually instead of the margins of society with the development of human society. As a highly complex adaptable tissue, although universities have an inherent quality of independent characters and values, but the social status and historical mission conferred by the era strongly demand universities should not only adapt to social change and meet the social needs, but also guide the development and progress of the society. Connotation of educational mission will has substantial change such as educational idea, teaching content, science research and social service from the perspective of ecological civilization.

articleTitle: Wood Nondestructive Test Based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: It is important to detect defects in wood, when it reduce the performance. The data and signal processing technology providing researchers with more damage identification problem solution ideas and methods. This article explore the wavelet analysis and artificial neural network for the wood defects based on non-destructive testing, and build an artificial neural network model for wood non-destructive testing technology. After wavelet packet decomposition to extract the different frequency bands of energy levels characteristic of the signal, as the neural network input samples, the network training and learning. Training of the BP network model can be achieved on the different locations automatic recognition of defects, defects of the middle of more than 90% recognition rate on the left and right side of the recognition rate of over 80%.

articleTitle: Measuring Average Revenue with Bandwidth and Traffic Demand on Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: We consider the revenue management problem on communication networks with multiple classes of traffic. Bandwidth allocation is determined to maximize revenue under network users' quality of service requirements. This paper presents the sensitivity analysis of an average revenue function for given traffic class by varying bandwidth allocation, traffic demand and the number of virtual paths. Numerical results show those relationships between model parameters and performance measures of interest.

articleTitle: A Proxy Multi-Signature Scheme with Proxy Revocation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: By the analysis of a proxy multi-signature scheme based on elliptic curve discrete logarithm problem proposed by Cao, this paper points out that it still has drawbacks, such as the absence of distinguishablility and undeniability properties, presence of proxy misuse. A new proxy multi-signature scheme with proxy revocation is proposed, which can resolve the proxy revocation and prevent proxy misuse by adding a signature center.

articleTitle: The Effect of Information Processing Mode on Cooperation in Social Dilemmas
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: How can individual difference in information processing promote cooperation in group interaction? In current study, two types of social dilemmas, give-some dilemmas and take-some dilemmas were compared and then explained from the perspective of information processing theory. It was proposed that the difference of cooperative levels between take-some and give-some dilemmas would disappear once people processed information in a rational way. Results confirmed the hypothesis. Results also showed that when participants processing information rationally were required to cooperate in a give-some dilemma, they engaged in more effort (in terms of reaction time and conflicting feeling) to balance their personal and collective interests.

articleTitle: A Novel Evolutionary Algorithm with Component-Based Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a component-based model with a novel ranking method (CMR) for constrained evolutionary optimization. In general, many constraint-handling technique inevitably solve two important problems: (1) how to generate the feasible solutions, (2) how to direct the search to find the feasible optimal solution. For the first problem, this paper introduces a component-based model. The model is useful for exploiting valuable information from infeasible solutions and for transforming infeasible solutions into feasible ones. Furthermore, a new ranking strategy is designed for the second problem. The new algorithm is tested on several well-known benchmark functions, and the empirical results suggest that it continuously found the optimums in 30 runs and has better standard deviations for robustness and stability.

articleTitle: Design of High-Speed Information Transmission Equipment Based on IEEE1394 Bus
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a design plan of the high-speed information transmission has been brought forward. The equipment which adopts open-style interface design can be used for the transmission of the audio and video information, as well as the high-speed datas information. The DSP chip is used as the controller of the information transmission system, and two 1394 chips are used as link layer and physical layer devices respectively. In the process of PCB board design, an anti-interference design which can improve the system stability has been added specially. Experiment shows that the transmission of the video information and the high-speed datas information can be realized by the transmission equipment. The equipment has good generality, and gets fine effect in actual application.

articleTitle: Applying Fourth Order Partial Differential Equation to Steady Incompressible Flow
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: According to steady 2D laminar stream-function vorticity equations, the fourth order partial differential equation was derived. As a governing equation, it was applied to cavity flow and sudden expansion flow. The results of computing tally with related references. It was proved that the fourth order partial differential equation is suitable for the flows and can be used to solve more complex flow.

articleTitle: Symmetric Construction of Biorthogonal Multiwavelets with Short Sequences
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach for constructing symmetric compactly supported biorthogonal multiwavelets with short sequences. Starting from the symmetric properties of scaling and wavelet functions, parameterized symmetric forms of the polyphase matrices can be derived, which greatly simplify the construction problem of compactly supported biorthogonal multiwavelets. Moreover, according to the perfect reconstruction matrix equations, the parameters of polyphase matrices can be reduced, which finally leads to our proposed algorithm for the construction of symmetric compactly supported biorthogonal multiwavelets with short sequences.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Actuality and Obstacles of Organizational Learning Based on Knowledge Fermenting Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: Based on knowledge fermenting theory, this paper analyzed the current situation and obstacles of organizational learning (OL) in its implementation process. Firstly, it analyzed the external driving force and the internal driving force of OL from the angle of knowledge enzyme. Secondly, it analyzed the knowledge source of OL from the concept of knowledge sourdough and knowledge matrix. Thirdly, the impact of various elements in the fermentation bar on OL is analyzed. Finally, it explored the contents and the technologies of OL. The correct assessment of the actuality make for bringing forward correct strategy for OL, therefore this paper would provide the useful reference for the smooth implementation of OL.

articleTitle: Strong Convergence Theorems for Arbitrary Sequence Series of B-Valued Random Variables
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: Based on martingale theory in Banach space, using the limit theorem of the B-valued martingale difference sequence, a strong limit theorem for arbitrary sequence series of B-valued random variables is obtained. In addition, according to Radon-Nikodym property of real number space, the main result of this paper contains some well known conclusions in the real number space.

articleTitle: Building P2P Volunteer Computing System Using Agents
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: A P2P volunteer computing system named PPVC is proposed. Its advantages are the flexible topology and the scalability. Volunteers are organized as a P2P network and a decentralized job scheduling method is utilized. It can accomplish an application efficiently under the dynamic changes of the P2P network condition. PPVC is built using an AOSE method and developed on the MAGE environment. The whole system is designed as a multi-agent system and thereby the key functions of the system are accomplished by agent's abilities and collaborations. Mobile agent is used for job remote execution and intelligent agent for job scheduling. Job splitting is mapped to agent cloning and result composing is corresponding to agent merging. All information exchange follows agent interaction protocols. The work approves the efficiency of the P2P architecture for volunteer computing and the feasibility of the AOSE method.

articleTitle: Ro-Ro Terminal Business Process Based on RFID Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: Currently, the Ro-ro transport is the most popular means of international motor transportation. A large quantity of Ro-ro terminals have been built in many Chinese ports to to promote the regional economy, more of them are under construction. The efficiency and effectiveness of Ro-ro terminals are to a large extent determined by the accessibility to information. Based on the project research, this paper has analysed the basic business process of the Ro-ro terminal as well as its acceleration effects generated by the RFID technology. Moreover, based on the RFID technology, the paper has designed the management information platform for Ro-ro terminal and clarified the primary procedures of Ro-ro operation in the information environment.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Coal and Natural Gas Co-Combustion in a Rotary Lime Kiln with Different Types of Coal
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the coal combustion condition, this essay based on an active lime rotary kiln in Wulongquan Limestone Mine of WISCO, focuses on the multifuel combustion of the coal together with natural gas by means of numerical simulation. To discuss the relationship of the flames with the coal composition, the cases with four different qualities of coal were compared. The gas phase is expressed with ¿-¿ two-equation turbulence model; the discrete phase with particle track model; the combustion with non-premixed model; and the radiation with PI radiation model. The results show that the volatile fraction content of coal has important impact on the early stage of the coal combustion; the natural gas burns out quickly to heat the coal and the gas flow.

articleTitle: Analyzing Agricultural Economy Data with Computational Intelligence Method
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: Computational intelligence, including mathematical modeling and statistical analysis, is always used in economy activities for quantitative analysis. For agriculture is so important that almost all states and regions pay special attention to its development. This paper collects China's 25 provinces agricultural fiscal support data and agriculture production cost data, analyzes the data with panel-data model, and then both 1dimensional and 2-dimensional clustering are utilized to scientifically classify these provinces into different kinds of agriculture-suitable regions. Consequently, based on this kind of quantitative analysis results about agricultural data, this paper proposes 3 kinds of agriculture development strategies.

articleTitle: Study and Implementation on the Visualization System Based on Strata Information
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: The technologies of geographic information system(GIS) and spatial information provide a new approach to solve complex problems in geotechnical engineering. This paper presents the design and the implementation of the geotechnical engineering information analysis and computation system (GIACS), in which the techniques of modeling for strata in three-dimensional space play an important role. In addition, a series of spatial analysis algorithms and techniques of the generation of multiple strata, the visualization expression of the strata, the real-time optimal adaptation of meshes, the expression of the body meshes of strata and the acquisition of the meshes of finite element method(FEM) are discussed. Based on the typical slope project in Longtan Hydropower Station, the model of three-dimensional strata founded on grid of multi-variant information is put forward. This study will make it possible for GIS to be successfully applied to geotechnical engineering and will give some useful references to the further researches.

articleTitle: Improved Neural Network Model Application with Information Entropy
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
abstract: The fourth party logistics (4PL) is a new logistics form and it's the result of professional and integrative logistics. The appraisal to the 4PL enterprise's core competence is imperative under the situation. The paper analyzed the 4PL enterprise's core competence, and established the index system of 4PL enterprise's core competence. On the basis of investigation about indexes of the 4PL enterprise's core competence, the paper established the improving neural network model with information entropy. Then, the paper applied information entropy to reduce index system, and found out more proper appraisal indexes of the 4PL enterprises. Then it used improved BP neural network model to appraise the 4PL enterprise's core competence. Via case analysis, proved this method's tangibility and validity to appraise the 4PL enterprise's core competence.

articleTitle: Parameter Estimations in Linear Regression Models with AR(2) Errors in Which the Parameters Have a Special Relationship
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Software Engineering
